items.what: The Bengaluru-based company allotted 93.08 lakh equity shares to anchor investors at Rs 404 apiece, the upper end of its IPO price band.
financials: The company’s revenue from operations rose 45.5% year-on-year to Rs 387 crore in FY26, while profit after tax jumped 142% to Rs 104.2 crore from Rs 43.1 crore in FY25.

items.title: BRICS: A Diplomatic Reset
items.blurb: BRICS today represents more than an economic grouping. It is increasingly becoming a symbol of a diplomatic reset against a global financial and political order that has remained heavily dominated by the United States and the Western powers for decades.
